source_behavior.authoritative_follow_up: site operation history is refreshed after synchronization

security.site_ownership: explicit tenant predicate on sync admission plus tenant-scoped workspace/API reads; foreign direct site ID is 404
security.csrf: web route stack and apiRequest X-CSRF-TOKEN
security.connector_gate: sync control stays disabled when the tenant-owned connector is missing or revoked

retry_and_reconciliation.receipt_scope: tenant + key with request hash bound to tenant/site/site.sync
retry_and_reconciliation.active_run_dedupe: queued/running SyncRun for the same site is reused
retry_and_reconciliation.queue_dispatch_failure: run is persisted failed; no success is returned
retry_and_reconciliation.frontend_mutation_retry: disabled; one key per explicit user action
retry_and_reconciliation.authoritative_reread: connection status and operation history are fetched only after a succeeded SyncRun
retry_and_reconciliation.operation_history: SyncSiteJob records succeeded/failed synchronization history without provider secrets

coverage: canonical source and dual route identity
idempotent replay without duplicate SyncRun or job dispatch

terminality.reason: The Site Connection Center Sync-now control is a real tenant-owned queued WordPress synchronization path on both canonical screens, is permission and connector gated, uses replay-safe idempotency and active-run convergence, treats failed/cancelled runs as failure, records operation history, and shows success only after a succeeded run followed by authoritative connection/history reread.
